revised_prompts:
Create one finished original vertical-scroll webtoon art shot, template webtoon-shot-v1. 1536x2048 pixels, keep a 6% safe margin. Korean webtoon style, clean polished 2D suspense panel.

Purpose: the unseen threat arrives first through two knocks from the empty corridor.

Composition / camera: insert shot, eye-level, portrait-lens feel, camera locked. View from inside the dining room straight toward the closed east door. Focus on the iron-banded oak door and the subtle vibration from the side being knocked. Leave the upper area above the door empty for SFX overlay. Static vertical composition.

Background space: use the dining hall setting from reference 2 only for environment identity. Show the iron-banded east oak door centered, surrounding doorframe, a thin dark cold seam of corridor at the edges, and the interior wooden floor beneath it. Include part of the dining room edge in foreground. Lighting is even interior light; the door seam feels colder and darker.

Foreground subject: use reference 1 only for character identity. Theo Waldhart appears only as a partial presence: at left lower area, only a small child’s hand and blue-gray sleeve visible beyond the table edge, no face. Tiny hand stopped over bread crumbs on the table edge/floor edge area, fingers frozen mid-motion. Preserve: small hand, blue-gray sleeve, no face. Gaze implied toward the door.

Placement: Theo hand at approximately left 6%, top 74%, width 16%, height 16%, foreground.

Depth layers: Theo’s hand and crumbs in foreground, closed door in midground, frame and dark corridor seam behind. Emphasize the crumbs stopped in place.

Visual treatment: crisp line only on the iron straps of the door and Theo’s fingertips; wood browns with cool gray shadows; concise 2D tension; mood is anxious because sound arrives before danger is seen. Subtle micro-vibration on door hardware/wood, but no exaggerated horror effect.

Continuity: screen direction right-to-left. State entering: Kyle and Theo were by the window; state leaving: the first knock turns every gaze to the door, Theo’s hand freezes over crumbs.

Lettering/layout: leave quiet negative space in region left 35%, top 10%, width 32%, height 18%. No speech balloons, no captions, no readable text, no watermark, no signature.

Avoid: speech bubbles, captions, readable text, watermark, signature, duplicate character, any person visible outside the door, horror effects, legible writing.
